title: Paramount Closes Warner Merger in Historic Hollywood Deal
summary:
Paramount Skydance Corp. closed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., combining two of the five largest Hollywood film studios and uniting major franchises such as Harry Potter and Mission Impossible.
The new company, called Skydance, will be home to dozens of TV networks and two major subscription streaming services, Paramount+ and HBO Max, and will be led by David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz as co-chief executive officers. Bloomberg's Hannah Miller joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: The Future Is Universal Health Insurance
summary: Employer-sponsored health insurance is rapidly deteriorating in the US. With premiums expected to increase by 11% next year, it’s time Americans embraced a universal public health insurance system, explains Bloomberg Opinion columnist Kathryn Anne Edwards. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Inside the Toys "R" Us Comeback
summary:
WHP Global is bringing Toys "R" Us back to life with over 120 new US stores despite falling consumer confidence. Yehuda Shmidman, the founder, chairman and CEO of the brand licensing company WHP Global, joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why toy demand is surging, the rise of the “kidult” shopper, and how an asset‑light licensing model is powering billions in sales and potential IPO plans.
